title: Nvidia Just Passed Intel. By A Lot.
hook: The chipmaker everyone ignored took the crown.
source: Company 10-K annual filings -- Nvidia (fiscal year ends late January, labeled by the calendar year most of the fiscal year falls in) vs. Intel (calendar year) revenue. 2024 figures as reported (Nvidia ~$130.5B, Intel ~$53.1B); earlier years as reported in each company's filings.
